layers.unit: Deterministic Node source and state test
layers.ci: Reviewed exact tested SHA with mandatory GitHub Actions
layers.browser-local: Local served 3D/2D actual browser action and audio evidence
layers.browser-hosted: Real staging or production host interaction with deployment manifest
layers.deployment: Host and generated backup SHA/content hash comparison

rules: Only check a roadmap task when the cases relevant to its exact completed scope pass with cited evidence; cases have no pre-certified pass status.
A local browser WebAudio pass does not establish hosted production playback.
Exact voice transcript, recorded speaker identity and earned quest outcomes must be independently verifiable.
Every RTD implementation PR must give task IDs in title and body, mapped RTAC IDs, checkpoint, commands, tested SHA and clear incomplete evidence.
Do not automatically assert test success from this acceptance contract; these are future acceptance requirements.

cases.title: Task ownership and stable references
cases.setup: Fresh canonical main, matching COORDINATION claim, specific RTD IDs in title/body and checkpoint
cases.expectedPass: PR names task(s), lists test evidence separately from acceptance, avoids overwriting unrelated agents; 93 stable IDs retained
cases.prohibitedFailure: Missing task ID, unknown ID, unverified checkbox or file conflict is a fail
cases.requiredEvidence: GitHub PR diff, title/body, coordination, checkpoint, CI URL

cases.title: Actor identity isolation
cases.setup: Named Rowan, worker Rowan and coordinate-keyed house resident with same display name
cases.expectedPass: Distinct stable actor keys keep independent memories, voice permission and interactions
cases.prohibitedFailure: Names merged, duplicated reward, voice borrowing or data leak
cases.requiredEvidence: Node identity contract, inventory parity

cases.title: Graph schema integrity
cases.setup: Valid graph plus duplicate node, missing link, illegal cycle, unreachable and dead-end fixtures
cases.expectedPass: Deterministic director accepts valid nodes and rejects malformed fixtures with useful errors
cases.prohibitedFailure: Crash, silently accepted bad link or nondeterministic output
cases.requiredEvidence: Node fixture output and test SHA

cases.title: Topic groups and priority
cases.setup: Two simultaneous valid topics, hidden topic, cooldown and repeatable topic
cases.expectedPass: Valid priority order, predicates and cooldown; back/change/replay/farewell work without unlocking hidden choice
cases.prohibitedFailure: Ineligible topic visible, duplicated cooldown event or wrong order
cases.requiredEvidence: Deterministic state/choice unit tests

cases.title: Greeting by encounter history
cases.setup: First visit, repeated visit, real landmark visit and saved quest stage
cases.expectedPass: Actor speaks correct eligible first/repeat/return greeting based on real saved evidence
cases.prohibitedFailure: Invented prior meeting or generic first-time greeting on return
cases.requiredEvidence: Unit scenario with saved flags

cases.title: Branch cancellation and rapid transitions
cases.setup: Open Rowan audio, switch to Kit, close/reopen, tap choices rapidly, resolve delayed audio promises
cases.expectedPass: Only current actor's clip/caption exists, old promise cannot resurrect; no duplicated effects
cases.prohibitedFailure: Stale actor audio, ghost caption or effect duplicated
cases.requiredEvidence: Playwright traces, source start/stop counters

cases.title: Recorded substitutions truthfulness
cases.setup: Template with changing item/player name, known clip fixed words
cases.expectedPass: Clip only plays when verified transcription exactly equals displayed caption; dynamic text separately announced as not recorded
cases.prohibitedFailure: Recorded voice implied to utter substituted words not in MP3
cases.requiredEvidence: Transcript/clip manifest audit, browser caption assertions

cases.title: Offline authored and AI separation
cases.setup: Disable Cloudflare AI/network while visiting named actor; ask unknown question separately
cases.expectedPass: Core authored choices work offline, AI is visibly separate, arbitrary AI cannot mutate world or claim an ElevenLabs recording
cases.prohibitedFailure: AI text presented as voice or offline core unusable
cases.requiredEvidence: Offline browser network trace and world snapshot

cases.title: Read-only world fact adapter
cases.setup: Clock, actual NPC position, open/closed shop, visits, rumour, witnessed social yarn
cases.expectedPass: Predicates use current authoritative values and separate confirmed events from lore/rumour
cases.prohibitedFailure: Made-up location, opening hours or witnessed event
cases.requiredEvidence: Node fact adapter fixtures, seeded TownLife test

cases.title: Quest availability
cases.setup: Quest stage 0/1/completed, challenge absent, player declines invitation
cases.expectedPass: Only allowed actions presented; accept/advance/complete invokes typed allowlisted authoritative command
cases.prohibitedFailure: Freeform response changes quest or stage skipped
cases.requiredEvidence: Unit quest-action tests, before/after state

cases.title: Repair success versus failure
cases.setup: Kit offers repair with/without tools, sufficient funds, cancelled job, genuine fail or success
cases.expectedPass: Success audio only after completed actual repair; cancelled/failed/insufficient states never play success
cases.prohibitedFailure: Success clip after failure or free click; wrong inventory/pay
cases.requiredEvidence: Town repair tests, clip event log

cases.title: Transaction idempotence
cases.setup: Rapid double click, reload mid-reward, stale network retry
cases.expectedPass: Exactly one committed transaction/reward with stable dedupe ID; state restores consistently
cases.prohibitedFailure: Double charge, double reward, replay-triggered pay
cases.requiredEvidence: Transaction state before/after JSON, Node regression

cases.title: Remembered social events
cases.setup: Confirmed two-NPC meeting, player visits and off-duty workday
cases.expectedPass: Return dialogue unlocks only saved witnessed event from correct identity, reproducibly across seeds
cases.prohibitedFailure: Rumour becomes witnessed truth, personal events cross actors
cases.requiredEvidence: Seeded scenario diff and social event log

cases.title: Versioned save and migration
cases.setup: Old save, new save, partial/corrupt export, invalid node reference, reload
cases.expectedPass: Migration preserves valid old gameplay while safely clearing obsolete dialogue stage; invalid input rejected without corruption
cases.prohibitedFailure: Lost inventory, stale reward, crash, private text export
cases.requiredEvidence: Save import/export tests, privacy review

cases.title: Memory privacy and consent
cases.setup: AI free text entered, user disables memory/exports save, private repository labels present
cases.expectedPass: Raw AI chat/credentials omitted from public export; consent/reset works; no private repo content in topic journal
cases.prohibitedFailure: Private secrets/chats exported or stored without consent
cases.requiredEvidence: Privacy gate, export inspection, consent browser test

cases.title: Approved voice manifest integrity
cases.setup: 100 Game300 clips/10 actors plus missing/invalid manifest entries
cases.expectedPass: Checks actor/clip SHA256/transcript/duration/voice ownership and original backups before use
cases.prohibitedFailure: Hash mismatch, wrong actor or corrupted clip accepted
cases.requiredEvidence: VoiceBank manifest and hash verification report

cases.title: Semantic clip triggers
cases.setup: Available greeting/help/ambient/choice and authentic result event
cases.expectedPass: Only semantically matching authored line used, exact subtitle; success/retry earned, no false overlay; tracker IDs cross-linked once
cases.prohibitedFailure: Generic unearned congratulations or text mismatch
cases.requiredEvidence: Recorded click traces, game state and event mapping

cases.title: Missing voice generation plan
cases.setup: Unvoiced named NPC, missing line and proposed Colab batch
cases.expectedPass: Missing-line manifest lists actor, exact script, preferred voice and approved Drive+GitHub storage; no paid run without consent
cases.prohibitedFailure: Borrowed voice, hallucinated recording or new key exposed
cases.requiredEvidence: Manifest diff, source location, owner approval and integrity hash

cases.title: Single playback authority and volume
cases.setup: NPC clip, yarn, ambience/music and fast switch during ZIP load
cases.expectedPass: Lazy user-gesture start, one active speaker, correct volume/stop/replay; low-memory browser remains responsive
cases.prohibitedFailure: Simultaneous overlapping speakers, uncontrolled data prefetch, mute of speech
cases.requiredEvidence: Playwright audio spies, network and volume trace

cases.title: Missing/broken media graceful fallback
cases.setup: 404, CORS, malformed ZIP/MP3, aborted stream, offline, suspended WebAudio
cases.expectedPass: Unavailable status shown, no wrong device speech impersonation, controls recover after retry; no paid TTS request
cases.prohibitedFailure: Silent fake success, crash, paid API call or infinite spinner
cases.requiredEvidence: Network fault-injection and browser error log

cases.title: Accessible conversation UI
cases.setup: Desktop keyboard, mobile portrait/landscape, focus/keyboard resize, screen reader and reduced motion
cases.expectedPass: Choice labels, actor/source/caption/status and back/exit discoverable; valid focus, touch targets, motion fallback; game controls restored
cases.prohibitedFailure: Trapped focus, obscured choices, impossible dismissal or unannounced clip
cases.requiredEvidence: Desktop/Pixel7 browser screenshots and accessibility assertions

cases.title: Optional AI grounding
cases.setup: Grounded scene question, fabricated-reward prompt, network denied
cases.expectedPass: Actual local scene facts answered or candid offline response; AI cannot cause quest/inventory writes or impersonate approved audio
cases.prohibitedFailure: Model-induced mutation or unsupported source assertions
cases.requiredEvidence: AI request stub, state snapshots, privacy assertion

cases.title: Rowan pilot full arc
cases.setup: Fresh player approaches Rowan; follow map/tour to actual landmark; save; meet again
cases.expectedPass: Appropriate first/return recorded actor clip and real landmark evidence; farewell and persistent milestone survive reload
cases.prohibitedFailure: Unvisited place marked visited, non-Rowan clip, no memory
cases.requiredEvidence: Walk-up browser recording, quest+save before/after, transcript

cases.title: Kit pilot full repair arc
cases.setup: Approach Kit, request quote, insufficient tools, cancel, then successfully repair
cases.expectedPass: Every branch follows actual inventory/tool/cost/job result, voice/caption fits and reward occurs once
cases.prohibitedFailure: Result claimed before work or after cancelled repair
cases.requiredEvidence: Playwright complete repair log, negative tests, audio map

cases.title: Pip pilot full dice arc
cases.setup: Approach Pip, select dice challenge, roll deterministic die, win/lose/retry, reload
cases.expectedPass: Spoken result matches actual rolled number/outcome; saved memory and replay don't reroll or reaward
cases.prohibitedFailure: Dice result invented by transcript or double reward
cases.requiredEvidence: Seeded roll tests, click sequence and approved audio

cases.title: Expansion to seven other voiced characters
cases.setup: Circuit, Wren, Sol, Sage, Spark, Lyra, Nova graphs and all authored conditions
cases.expectedPass: Each character has unique correct actor voice, reachable topics, honest missing-line state and regression coverage
cases.prohibitedFailure: Cross-actor voice or unreachable content
cases.requiredEvidence: Per-character fixture and desktop/mobile traces

cases.title: Unvoiced cast, workers and NPC yarns
cases.setup: 22 unvoiced named actors, worker and house identity, recorded street yarn
cases.expectedPass: No borrowed MP3; expansion clearly optional, confirmed overheard topic only; 99 workers are distinct from 188 coordinate residents
cases.prohibitedFailure: Claim worker has approved bespoke voice without clip, invented yarn
cases.requiredEvidence: Cast inventory, browser captions and event log

cases.title: Deterministic negative-and-stress tests
cases.setup: Bad actor/branch/condition, false transaction, wrong manifest, rapid change, ZIP faults
cases.expectedPass: Every negative fixture fails safely and no side effect leaks
cases.prohibitedFailure: Any rejected fixture changes game state or speaks wrong voice
cases.requiredEvidence: Node/Playwright failure injectors and regression results

cases.title: Complete desktop and Android browser journeys
cases.setup: 3D walk, enter room, approach NPC, choose topic, hear/replay/stop, swap, leave, sleep, reload
cases.expectedPass: Both desktop 1280x800 and Android-style 390x844 complete journey without stuck movement, lost focus, corrupt saves or overlapping audio
cases.prohibitedFailure: Any path blocked or result/voice mismatch
cases.requiredEvidence: Recorded Playwright video, console trace, game-state log

cases.title: Whole-town regression and privacy gate
cases.setup: Canonical tested SHA and merged game-code changes
cases.expectedPass: Focused voice/graph tests, npm run build:release, privacy, world simulations, release integrity, required CI all pass
cases.prohibitedFailure: Skipped/failed mandatory gate or private repo leak
cases.requiredEvidence: Exact SHA, GitHub Actions IDs and test log

cases.title: Staging hosted WebAudio validation
cases.setup: Existing staging URL deployed with approved build commit, actor and quest scenario
cases.expectedPass: Real hosted DOM/3D player gesture starts approved MP3, correct transcript, and real quest effect, without errors
cases.prohibitedFailure: Only localhost tested, wrong deployed SHA, skipped step or no actual audio start
cases.requiredEvidence: Staging release.json, URL, SHA, recorded browser traces

cases.title: Canonical production approval
cases.setup: Approved exact tested commit promoted to existing production Vercel alias
cases.expectedPass: Production release.json sourceCommit/contentHash matches deployed SHA and tested artifact; real hosted voice + full quest journey pass
cases.prohibitedFailure: CI-only proof, stale release, skipped hosted browser or partial rollout marked complete
cases.requiredEvidence: Vercel deployment ID, manifest and production browser run

cases.title: Backup release parity
cases.setup: Production READY manifest and generated GitHub Pages backup manifest
cases.expectedPass: Same approved sourceCommit and contentHash on both; no direct mirror modifications
cases.prohibitedFailure: Mixed fingerprints, generated mirror hand edits, unverified rollback
cases.requiredEvidence: Production+Pages release URLs and SHA256 comparison

cases.title: Evidence archive and open-item honesty
cases.setup: PR includes implementation, test/media output and checkpoint, with any blocked tests
cases.expectedPass: Screenshots/logs/recording map linked, RTD statuses accurate, unresolved checks stay open with blocker
cases.prohibitedFailure: Unsupported success, missing logs or silently checked unimplemented work
cases.requiredEvidence: PR checklist, checkpoint and GitHub commit links
